question: When the first proper discrepancy route reaches equal depth and loses, does that route itself contain a broad set of already-generated, locally better runner-ups that can support one bounded second discrepancy?

relationship_to_prior_work.attribution: On focused seeds 128-135, proper discrepancy accounts for +27.6140 versus production while yielding adds only +3.3520 versus proper, split six better and six worse. The catalog regressions have no yield actions and also arise from proper discrepancy.
relationship_to_prior_work.direction: Improve route quality inside discrepancy search rather than tune when a single greedy route is stopped.
relationship_to_prior_work.cleanup: The closed yielding policy, outcome, controller state, counters, and live traversal are removed. The offline analyzer retains compatibility for its archived evidence.

instrument.behavior: Exactly the retired proper-discrepancy traversal: one positive, nonzero-advance inner runner-up may be extended after the primary causal route loses. No second runner-up is executed.
instrument.new_observation: For that first local route, record every nonpreferred non-skipped child still live and outside deadline pressure when it ends, using the same exact incumbent-relative prefix gain, remaining advance, and conservative margin semantics as the first-discrepancy map.
instrument.fixed_live_policy_if_supported: Only if the first local route reaches the tournament target and loses, choose at most one of its positive-gain, nonzero-advance runner-ups by the unchanged stable maximum gain-times-deadline-margin rule, extend it greedily to the original target, and perform one final strict equal-depth comparison. No third discrepancy or recursive beam is allowed.
trust: first-level opportunity summaries must continue to read only causal-route choices
nested choices must be attributed only to the exact local route that generated them
every choice must still be live, affordable, non-skipped, and exactly comparable with the suspended prefix at its gap
candidate and retained proper-discrepancy tracks, scores, and validity must be exactly identical

predeclared_map.seed_reuse_reason: These seeds are reused only to map mechanics inside already-observed proper-discrepancy routes. Scores are excluded from selection evidence.
predeclared_map.selection_rule: Build exactly the fixed second-discrepancy policy only if at least 12 losing first-local routes have a positive-gain, nonzero-advance nested runner-up, spanning at least six runs and both requested sources. Otherwise close without a live arm.
predeclared_map.next_step_if_selected: Implement one bounded second-discrepancy environment, prove exact parentage, stable argmax, primary/local losses, target reach, and maximum depth two, then run a fresh focused 750k screen on actual seeds 138-145 before any catalog or canonical evaluation.
predeclared_map.non_claim: The map establishes action-set breadth only. It cannot predict the unexecuted route, final score, headline, multi-budget behavior, or promotion outcome.

result.decision: Advance exactly the fixed bounded second-discrepancy policy. Twelve qualifying routes meet the fixed route minimum and span nine runs and both sources; exact identity and analyzer trust checks pass.
result.interpretation: The first greedy local route often loses while its own subtree retains an affordable, locally superior branch. This establishes action breadth only; the second route has not yet been executed.
